intent.problem: Software expectations are scattered across specifications, docs and custom rules.

safety.reason: Inspect source without executing programs or applying fixes.

product.benefit: See which expectations have implementation evidence and which need attention.
product.how_it_works: Extracts rules from SPEC.md, docs and knowledge, asks the supervisor to review them in Chat, and investigates each rule only after explicit approval.
product.input: Local repository checkout or plain source/docs folder; optional Markdown rules in knowledge/rules/.
product.output: Editable rules.md and a Markdown table of rules, pass/fail/unknown, exact references and 0–1 confidence.
product.customizable_for: Software expectations and prohibitions supplied as Markdown.
